queries.accounts: SELECT account_id, date AS opened_at FROM account ORDER BY account_id
queries.owners:
SELECT account_id, client_id FROM disp
                 WHERE type = 'OWNER' ORDER BY account_id
queries.transactions:
SELECT trans_id, account_id, date AS trans_date,
                            type, operation, k_symbol, amount, balance
                       FROM trans ORDER BY account_id, date, trans_id

run_manifest.selection_metric: validation average_precision; tie: lower Brier; tie: fixed candidate order

bootstrap.method: percentile, unstratified, conditional on fitted model and threshold

postprocessing_audit.pr_rendering: step plot; metrics and predictions unchanged
postprocessing_audit.scope: diagnostic only; no refitting or threshold selection
